flows.title: Download receipts in bulk
steps: Only admins can download receipts. Go to Expenses > Transactions, or to the Reimbursements tab.
Filter the History tab by any date, then click the download icon at the top right and select the file type.
A small download goes to the browser's download folder; a larger one arrives by email, as a ZIP file to download. A single receipt can be downloaded from its receipt icon or its transaction instead.
